does: Rolls a damage formula's dice on the damage roll stream through RollDiceWithBoosts, so that the damage pin bounds each die; called by the deal-damage functor's path and by the AI's scoring of stats functors.

evidence.says: GK.Memory.Watch on the host's PlayerDamage roll stream NumRolls: in a fair melee hit for 4 (dagger 1d4 pinned at 1, + 3) two draws (bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x105AAE3) in the frame of the damage, both returning through bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x10713AF of this function into bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x36E9347 (code:unplaced::RollDealDamageFunctor), one from stats::DealDamageFunctor::ApplyDamage (bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x36EA93B), one from code:unplaced::DealDamageFunctorAtPosition (bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x36EC3FC); in a miss one draw, through code:unplaced::DealDamageFunctorAtPosition only
The count write of the PlayerDamage stream after a weapon attack returns through bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x10713AF inside this function, called from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x36E9347
The formula is rolled through the roll with boosts with no difficulty
